notes: A coalition assignment, not a quest: there is no Quest Header and no Start field, and the walkthrough deliberately never names its NPC -- it says 'NPC asks you' and 'Trade these to the NPC'. Objective 'Procure 3 spools of Bloodthread' becomes item name 'Bloodthread' count 3 -- the wikitext links [[Bloodthread]] and 'spools of' is the page's measure word, not part of the name.
